_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::multiscale#2 — a FALSIFICATION. The entry described a MICRO_SOLVER_ID key linking the micro scale to the macro deck's SOLVER definitions, warned about with 'MICRO_SOLVER_ID X not found among macro SOLVER definitions' or 'null pointer to micro Belos solver'. No such key exists: MICRO_SOLVER_ID_IN_SCHEMA=0 against the binary's own --parameters. The micro input file is a complete 4C input that names its own solver through its own LINEAR_SOLVER / SOLVER n blocks. Pointing that at an undefined id gives NO 4C error block at all (BAD_FOURC_ERROR_BLOCKS=0) — an unhandled Teuchos::Exceptions::InvalidParameterName, 'Error!  The parameter "SOLVER" does not exist in the parameter (sub)list "ROOT->SOLVER 7"', and shell status 134. The absence of the usual PROC 0 ERROR banner is the point: the normal way of reading a 4C failure finds nothing here. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave the micro deck pointing at the solver it defines. The Teuchos abort vanishes, EXIT_BAD becomes 0, and the fixture must go red.
